properties.description:
Five tests in `crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_published_promise_carries_its_evidence.rs`: the check on a published Requirement travels; the check on a published Interface travels; a check on an INTERNAL requirement stays home and so does the requirement; a design publishing nothing still exports no checks; and `SurfaceExport.evidence` names the carried checks, sorted.

OBSERVED FAILING first — the two "travels" tests red, the two "stays home" tests passing vacuously, which is the shape a carve-out's tests take before the carve-out exists.

ALSO MEASURED AGAINST THE REAL DESIGN rather than only the fixtures: 3 of 315 Verifications travel on reflow2's own surface, and two of those three carry internal build paths and ChangeEvent ids in `findings` — which is what turned the disclosure from a documented risk into a named one.

RE-RUN: `cargo test -p reflow2-core --no-default-features --test a_published_promise_carries_its_evidence`.
properties.findings: 5/5 green 2026-09-22 after two were observed red. Full core suite 183 suites green, both clippy clean.
properties.name: The check on a published target travels, one on an internal target stays home, and the report names what left
